deferred_minors.finding: The reused application-completion probe locates Vue private _vei invokers and replaces invoker.value. This is framework-internal coupling rather than a public test API.
deferred_minors.cost_if_wrong: A future Vue event-dispatch refactor may break these browser tests even when the reader behavior remains correct; it currently fails explicitly for a missing handler or non-Promise action rather than accepting HTTP completion as application completion.
deferred_minors.disposition: Retain as a bounded maintenance issue; no generic refactor or assertion weakening requested for this tranche. This helper predates the present evidence-locator change and is reused by its stale-completion checks.

root_rulings.ruling: The reader validates all 17 required Evidence fields, exact EvidencePage/ObjectRef/TimeRange/BoundingBox keys, scalar/null constraints, identifier/hash/version/date shapes and per-item case/task/run/result bindings against the selected source. No invented evidence/object/snapshot SHA equality is imposed.
root_rulings.cost_if_wrong: Claiming content integrity or authorization from structural validation would overstate what frontend metadata validation proves.
root_rulings.boundary: Media duration, original bytes, provenance truth and current authorization remain backend/provider responsibilities; this reader does not fetch original media to verify them.

root_rulings.ruling: Current context and historical review sources preserve their own run/result versions; historical selection displays only listed evidence IDs and reports IDs absent from this response without asserting global absence.
root_rulings.cost_if_wrong: Binding historical evidence to the latest context would silently misattribute review history to another run or conceal missing linked evidence.
root_rulings.boundary: An absent ID in a partial response does not prove no matching evidence exists in the full collection.

root_rulings.ruling: The request uses only the mounted evidence GET with exact history run/result selectors and requires matching X-Task-Id, X-Run-Version and X-Result-Version headers even for an empty page. It does not send limit/cursor, fetch media/object URLs, POST or invoke algorithms.
root_rulings.cost_if_wrong: Invented pagination parameters would be rejected by the current backend, and treating a historical metadata GET as a media/content operation would bypass unimplemented controls.
root_rulings.boundary: A nonnull next_cursor is explicitly incomplete with no automatic continuation or next-page control; complete evidence pagination remains unimplemented.

root_rulings.ruling: The reader requires an authenticated user, review.read and evidence.read plus visible case membership before any request. It tracks generation, user, org, roles, permissions, case membership and full selection/source signature. Source refresh, historical page reload, identity or parent selection changes clear selection and dispose the old reader.
root_rulings.cost_if_wrong: Failure to clear any of those boundaries could leave old-case or old-identity evidence visible or allow a stale response to replace the new scope.
root_rulings.boundary: The existing CurrentUser runtime-validation boundary is not repaired by this tranche; server authority checks remain necessary regardless of client predicates.

root_rulings.ruling: The reader uses generation/signature/disposal checks before assigning success, failure or busy state. Native-unit cases await the actual load Promise after late success/error. The new browser stale checks wrap and await the Vue action Promise, including validation/catch/finally, before asserting the stale data/error stays absent.
root_rulings.cost_if_wrong: Only waiting for HTTP completion can falsely pass stale-error assertions before the application catch/finally has run.
root_rulings.boundary: Browser stale-success/source-refresh and stale-error/unmount pairings are not a complete cross-product of all mutations/outcomes; native reader tests cover the larger state-change matrix.

root_rulings.ruling: Vue interpolation displays controlled metadata as text. The locator does not create image/video/audio/link nodes from object references and does not infer permissions or approval validity from historical decisions.
root_rulings.cost_if_wrong: Rendering object metadata as an executable URL or claiming recorded decisions authorize current actions would change the security boundary.
root_rulings.boundary: This is readonly metadata location, not playback, evidence certification, review submission, draft storage, approval or complete T103 acceptance.

root_rulings.ruling: The review is fresh local static inspection only. Root owns actual full-unit/browser command results, exact-source hashes after any further changes, CI status/head verification, task/nav updates and three-end source synchronization.
root_rulings.cost_if_wrong: Reusing previous review or CI success could mark an untested source or failed gate as verified.
root_rulings.boundary: No internet, GitHub, SSH, browser tool, test process, product modification or commit was performed by this reviewer. Self-owned transport fixtures are not real-authority/backend E2E.

independent_review.root_disposition: Retain existing nonblocking Vue private event-handler fixture coupling; current source/identity/header/binding tests verified. No content, media-duration, paging, approval or real-provider E2E claim; no assertion weakening.

findings.fact: OpenAPI declares limit/cursor, but history.router.read_result allows only history selector keys for getTaskEvidence; unknown query parameters return READ_PARAMETER_UNSUPPORTED422.
findings.required_behavior: Use only exact history selector query. No next-page request; if next_cursor is non-null, explicitly mark returned portion incomplete and preserve missing references as unresolved. Do not claim complete evidence collection.

findings.fact: Historical response binding headers are supported by existing router and exposed by BusinessClient Reply.history.
findings.required_behavior: Validate all three headers against the selected task/run/result. Header absence, malformed positive integer, mismatched identity/version, duplicate evidence IDs, or invalid Evidence schema rejects display.

findings.fact: Evidence contains exact case_id/task_id/run_version/result_version fields; page itself has only items/next_cursor.
findings.required_behavior: Validate every returned Evidence against selected case/task/run/result, including items not referenced by the selected Review; reject the entire invalid response rather than silently filter cross-case facts.

findings.fact: BoundingBox is original-media normalized x/y/width/height, x/y in[0,1], width/height in(0,1], and x+width<=1/y+height<=1.
findings.required_behavior: Check finite numbers and cross-field sums; label normalized coordinates. Do not interpret as pixel coordinates. No fabricated overlays/media dimensions.

findings.fact: TimeRange is half-open milliseconds[start_ms,end_ms), end>start; media upper bound is a semantic requirement but Evidence alone contains no duration.
findings.required_behavior: Check nonnegative/positive safe integers and strict order, label milliseconds/half-open. Do not assert media-duration bounds verified without authoritative media metadata.

findings.fact: ObjectRef is controlled object_id/version_id/sha256, not a public URL or storage key. Nullable object_ref/time_range/bbox/model fields remain legitimate nulls.
findings.required_behavior: Render escaped text/null meaning. Never treat identifier as URL, append storage URL, infer sha256 equality between distinct Evidence.sha256 and ObjectRef.sha256 absent a defined semantic relation, or imply bytes were fetched/verified by frontend.

findings.fact: ReviewContext is latest task_result metadata and does not include case_id/evidence_ids. Historical Review records independently preserve task/run/result/evidence_ids and policy_version.
findings.required_behavior: Select context or one historical Review explicitly; preserve each target own versions. Current context reads complete returned page facts; historical Review resolves only its evidence_ids and lists each unresolved reference. Never silently fall back to latest.

findings.fact: Repository load_exact verifies canonical snapshot SHA, binding/current inputs, current source authorization and current object/evidence references; projection validates JSONSchema and recursively enforces present binding fields. Existing test coverage uses synthetic authority fixtures.
findings.required_behavior: Reuse existing mounted read operation; no backend/schema changes needed for this bounded frontend read. Local/browser fixture tests do not become real-authority/backend/model E2E claims.

findings.fact: No dataset/model acquisition needed for read-only transport and validation tests; existing non-sensitive fixtures suffice. Algorithm-producing source dependencies remain uncompleted.
findings.required_behavior: Retain original dependencies/fulltask remaining conditions. Do not invent completed model findings, media truth or formal authorization.

findings.fact: Current session identity includes generation/user/org/roles/permissions/case_ids; case/task/page changes and parent prop selection also affect displayed evidence.
findings.required_behavior: Clear evidence/selection on identity, case, task, source context/history selection or history-page change and unmount. Ignore late successes/errors only after actual reader completion; no old selection resurrection.
